# pixelfx (vendored)

Copy of `src/` from [patch-gg/pixelfx](https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx) version 0.3.1, MIT License (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md`).
Kept in the repo so `node build.mjs` works without a sibling checkout.

Not copied: `gallery/` (its Patch Pixel font is not MIT-licensed), `docs/`, `skills/`, `tools/`.
To update: replace `vendor/pixelfx/src` with the new release's `src/` and run `node build.mjs`.
